description: Bohr atom for Oxygen with custom electron (blue) and proton (red) colors, showing 8 electrons across two shells.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_chemistry import BohrAtom

class BohrAtomOxygen(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        atom = BohrAtom(
            e=8, p=8, n=8,
            electron_color=BLUE,
            proton_color=RED,
            orbit_color=GREY,
        )
        label = Text("Oxygen (O)", font_size=28).next_to(atom, DOWN)
        self.add(atom, label)
        self.wait(0.5)
